summary: There’s an old adage that you should never bring a knife to a gunfight. My take on OpenAI’s response yesterday was expressing incredulity that OpenAI was bringing, like, a box of chocolates to the gunfight. Apple is trying to kill io, and OpenAI’s public response is basically “ We love you guys, can’t we just be friends? ” This thread on Hacker News though…
title: Hacker News Thread on OpenAI’s ‘Apple Is Getting This Wrong’ Post
